versions.changelog:
xhs-note-downloader-guaikei v1.0.0

- Initial release with four key commands for Xiaohongshu note and KOL analysis scenarios.
- Supports real-time retrieval of public note details, comments, and creator posts, including interaction data (likes, comments, favorites).
- Flexible keyword search, individual note detail, comment extraction, and creator work monitoring.
- Includes detailed usage patterns, error handling, and explicit environment requirements.
- Designed for evaluating KOL authenticity, content trends, and campaign decision support—not for internal or follower count data.
